ctx.x: Andre Persiani, yeah. So now, I liked it very much, but the same woman that runs this place -- well, in the first place the guys were getting a bit peeved. Nelson said, "Now, it is going to be awful over here now. I hear the woman wants you to come down here and work." I said, "Yeah, she found a sound -- but you all don't have to worry about it." "No," he says, "it's too many, man. She'll be getting us for nothing pretty soon. Everybody she brings in, she'll get you cheaper." I said, "Well, I have a price, and…
